name: Kio Najime
source:
A girl who is always crying and timid. Quiet and polite, but mentally unstable.

​Perhaps because she hasn't been treated well as usual, she is vulnerable to people's kindness. There's a side of her that is addictive and dependent....

[Translated from [url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/sadisma]official website[/url]]
